title: Brother Of The Brother (Kinship Graph)
style: minimal house, 116 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, soft sidechain pad, deep dub bass, vocal-chop one-syllable hook, library-card-catalogue clicks
lyrics:
[Intro]
node to node, edge to edge
family tree on a database ledge

[Verse 1]
one name comes, then a second name
linked by blood or just the same
operator says it, I draw the line
brother of the brother, that's fine

[Pre-Chorus]
don't ask sister, don't ask cousin
log what's said, that's the dozen

[Chorus]
brother of the brother, edge in the graph
kinship adjacency, half a laugh
might be siblings, might be slang
not my call, just the clang
brother of the brother, in the row
that is all the records show

[Verse 2]
some families call a friend a bro
some call a brother every joe
doesn't change the entry made
doesn't change how the file's laid

[Chorus]
brother of the brother, edge in the graph
kinship adjacency, half a laugh
might be siblings, might be slang
not my call, just the clang
brother of the brother, in the row
that is all the records show

[Outro]
edge added, query closed
next relation, next disposed
